title: Mochizuki Honami — Grateful For Courage〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Don't Let Doubts Hold You Back

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Classroom

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hello. This is Honami Mochizuki from Class 1-B. I'm here to talk about the choir recital.

rows.Speaker: Choir Recital Chairman
rows.Line: Okay. Has your class decided on its free choice selection?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We're going to sing Smile Tomorrow Too.

rows.Speaker: Choir Recital Chairman
rows.Line: Smile Tomorrow Too is a great choice, but also very difficult. Are you sure about this?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. We decided on the song together as a class.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And I'm truly sorry you had to wait for us because of this...

rows.Speaker: Choir Recital Chairman
rows.Line: Don't worry about it. Your class wasn't the only one that took a while to decide.

rows.Speaker: Choir Recital Chairman
rows.Line:
You've got your work cut out for you,
but thank you for your song choice!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, yes...! Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We'll need to come up with a practice schedule that works for everyone after this.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
(Also, I'm feeling a little drained.
Maybe I'll take a little detour before going back.)
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sigh... I'm just so glad it all worked out somehow...

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Everyone has stuff going on in their lives, so we should just go for something simpler.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: But can't you see we're trying to drum up some enthusiasm here? You really should've kept all those demoralizing excuses to yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (When they started arguing, I didn't know what was going to happen...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Please allow me to say something before we begin.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm glad I mustered up the courage to do it...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I'm glad I trusted my classmates...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (And it was all because...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're making it pretty obvious you think your current friends would turn on you given half a chance.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (It was a because of Shiho and MEIKO.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think I've figured it out. What I needed was the courage to speak my mind... And the courage to trust my friends.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
There she is!
Honamiii!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Honami! We were looking for you!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: We thought something happened because you were taking so long to get back!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Emu... Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: W-Wah! Honami, why are you crying?!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
What happened, Honami?
Did the committee say something mean to you?!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Was it because we took too long to choose our song?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: That wasn't Honami's fault! Who do they think they are?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah! You didn't do anything wrong!
Hnng! I'm so angry now!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Me too! I'm gonna go give that committee a piece of my mind!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hang on! W-Wait, please!
You've got it all wrong...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm crying out of relief because we finally all managed to agree on a song...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Really, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, really. Thank you all for being so concerned about me.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then that's great!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But if you were sent to look for me, it must mean that everyone in the class is waiting for us, right? We should hurry back.
Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sorry for taking so long, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Welcome back, Mochizuki!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... Yes. I'm finally back.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: We've been trying to come up with a schedule together while you were gone.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: It's still pretty rough but can you take a look and tell us what you think?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You did all of this...?

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Honestly, some of us still aren't in the mood yet, but that doesn't mean we want you to do all the heavy lifting.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: We'll help out with whatever we can.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup yup! Let's make the recital fun for everyone!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe... Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Alright, everyone.
Let's start talking about our practice schedule!
